name: stjorna-pocketbase
description: PocketBase backend + integration tests for STJÓRNA

scripts.test:sequential: for f in tests/auth.test.ts tests/multitenant.test.ts tests/webhooks.test.ts tests/collections/categories.test.ts tests/collections/media.test.ts tests/collections/products.test.ts tests/collections/tenants.test.ts; do echo "Running $f" && (podman ps -q --format "{{.ID}}" | xargs -r podman stop 2>/dev/null || docker ps -q | xargs -r docker stop 2>/dev/null || true); npx vitest run "$f" || exit 1; done
